title: System Information Gathering
objective: Collect baseline data on the operating system, kernel version, installed packages, and network configuration.
rationale: Understanding the current state is necessary to scope the assessment and identify potential outdated components.
expected_output: Comprehensive report detailing OS version, kernel version, installed package list (e.g., dpkg -l or rpm -qa), and network interfaces.
success_criteria: A list of all major installed packages is generated.
